projects.name: Resume AI
bullets: Built a **Generative AI** resume builder that generates tailored resumes and calculates an **ATS** keyword-matching score with auto-rewrite functionality.
Implemented a **RAG** pipeline in **FastAPI** using **TF-IDF** vectorization to retrieve relevant HR guidelines before generating content with **LLMs**.
Reduced generation time from **75s** to under **30s** by parallelizing independent tasks with Python thread pools; integrated **JWT** auth and **SQLAlchemy** for user persistence.
Deployed frontend to Vercel and backend to **AWS EC2** inside **Docker** with configured volumes, environment secrets, and CORS headers.

projects.name: Notes App
bullets: Built a full-stack note-taking application from scratch to understand the complete request lifecycle without starter templates.
Implemented **JWT** authentication on **Express.js**, **MongoDB** storage, and **React/Redux** state management on the frontend.
Designed server-side search with chained Mongoose filters and optimized sort order for note pinning across both backend queries and Redux state.
